one_line: Error tracking and application performance monitoring platform.
auth_notes: Web API authenticates with auth tokens (user or org-level, scope-limited); OAuth2 for integrations; region-specific domains (us.sentry.io, de.sentry.io).
self_serve_notes: Free developer tier with paid Team/Business plans; auth tokens are self-service in account settings.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Organizations, projects, teams, issues/events, releases, dashboards, crons, profiling, replays, SCIM, alerts.
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for alert rules and event/issue activity.

existing_mcp.note: Official Sentry MCP server exists (getsentry/sentry-mcp); community servers also exist.

evidence.note: Fetched text is the Sentry API Reference overview confirming the web API, auth tokens, scopes, pagination, and rate limits.

agent_notes: Official MCP is community-edition open source; still verifiable existence.
